note: NOTE: General item table. item_type = material | gear | currency | misc | consumable. subtype_id is used for materials only. Currencies: Nature / Elemental / Spirit Essence (category upgrades) and Monster Essence (basic skills only); Copper Coin is money. Consumables are meadow-flavored (Meadow Dew, Clear Dew, Spring Draught, Mint Draught, Barley Cake, Wild Apple, Mint Sprig). They can be bought from the Meadows vendor (npc_shop). Healing and MP drinks drop only from some thematically related monsters, not from every mob. Misc includes common junk, a few mid curios (found objects, hoarded things, byproducts — not a body-part trophy on every monster), and rare high-sell junk that only some monsters share. Crafting is deferred. Meadows leans earth. v0.1.2-descs: `desc` is the short player-facing line shown in tooltips (flavor only, no design notes). `notes` is design-only and is never shown in game. Mechanical consumable effects ("Restores 40 HP") live in notes and are shown as stats. `description` is kept in sync with `desc` for older exports.  v0.2.3: Wild Apple retired from shop and drops (kept so old bags still work). Strawberry restores HP, Blueberry restores MP; mouse and sheep each drop one, slightly above the old apple rate. Short Sword is a plain shop weapon at 30 Copper.  v0.2.4: Spark Shell (Spark Bug unique junk) and Pale Wing (Frost Moth unique junk).
